backend/main.mo: Defines the main backend actor handling user profiles and full CRUD for categories, vendors, banks, expenses, revenue, and COGS items, purchases, and sales with authorization and ID counters.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a migration function that upgrades old actor state by adding empty COGS collections and initializing new ID counters.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence mapping COGS-related UI and query-layer changes to files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files including routing, pages, components, styles, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, including layout and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: Provides the base HTML page loading the React app and setting metadata and root container.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router, authentication gating, profile setup flow, and routes for all major app pages.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Implements the main layout with header navigation, logout handling, content container, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/KpiCard.tsx: Displays a KPI card with a formatted value and variant-based styling including an icon.
frontend/src/components/NumericCell.tsx: Renders a table cell showing a number formatted as currency, percent, or plain number.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Shows a dialog to collect and save a user’s name with loading feedback.
frontend/src/components/TimeWindowSelect: Dropdown selector for choosing predefined time windows like day or month ranges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for Internet Identity login, logout, and identity management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines data queries and mutations for profiles, categories, and other backend resources with auto-seeding logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base setup with theme variables, utility classes, dark mode, and print styles.
frontend/src/lib/constants/paymentMethod: Defines the fixed list of allowed payment methods and its type.
frontend/src/lib/seed/restaurantCategori: Provides default restaurant categories and seed versioning for initial app setup.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function to merge and dedupe class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query and identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsItemsTab.tsx: Displays and manages COGS inventory items, providing a table view and a dialog for adding or editing items.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsPurchasesTab: Shows purchase records and allows adding or editing COGS purchases with item and vendor selection.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSalesTab.tsx: Lists sales records and provides a dialog for creating or editing COGS sales entries.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/CogsSummaryTab.t: Calculates and displays total COGS for a selected time range and renders monthly trend data.
frontend/src/pages/cogs/utils.ts: Utility helpers for mapping item/vendor IDs to names and converting between dates and nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/CogsPage.tsx: Renders the COGS page with tab navigation for items, purchases, sales, and summary sections.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays financial KPIs and quick stats with a selectable time window using dashboard query data.
frontend/src/pages/ExpensesPage.tsx: Manages expense records with add/edit dialogs and displays a table of expenses with related metadata.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides a simple login screen using Internet Identity with loading feedback.
frontend/src/pages/MasterDataPage.tsx: Hosts tabs for managing categories, vendors, banks, and payment methods with CRUD dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Generates filtered financial reports over selectable date ranges, including expenses, revenue, and COGS totals.
frontend/src/pages/RevenuePage.tsx: Manages revenue entries with add/edit dialogs and displays a table of recorded revenue.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides URL and session parameter helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration adding custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON file describing the FoodBooks project's state, including existing features, pending COGS-related feature requests, and metadata.
